brief.text: Biotechnology and pharmaceutical names saw the largest single commitments, led by Baker Bros. Advisors LP placing $35.0 million into MDGL and $24.3 million into KOD, alongside a $15.0 million individual purchase in KMI by Richard Kinder. In cluster activity, UPBD drew an unusually broad group of seven distinct insiders purchasing a combined $1.39 million, while TTMI logged the largest total cluster value at $3.6 million across three buyers. Additionally, Saba Capital Management registered notable individual purchases across four separate closed-end funds, including MXF and JOF.
